name: org.machanism.machai:project-layout
description: Project Layout is a Java utility library for describing, detecting, and working with conventional project directory layouts. It centralizes rules for locating production sources, test sources, resources, documentation, modules, and project metadata so build tooling, scanners, generators, validation utilities, documentation tools, and plugins do not need to hard-code ecosystem-specific folder conventions. The library provides reusable abstractions and concrete layout strategies for Maven, Gradle, JavaScript package.json projects, Python projects, and generic fallback directory structures. It includes support for Maven metadata through PomReader and layout selection through ProjectLayoutManager, making it useful for heterogeneous repositories, Maven multi-module projects, repository scanners, code generators, static analysis tools, project indexing, and Machai tooling integrations.

constructors.description: Creates a Maven-specific project layout resolver. Configure it with org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout.projectDir(java.io.File) before reading source, test, document, module, or metadata paths.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout layout = new org.machanism.machai.project.layout.MavenProjectLayout().projectDir(new java.io.File("/path/to/maven-project"));
java.util.Collection<java.lang.String> sources = layout.getSources();
examples.description: Creates a Maven layout resolver, configures the target root directory, and retrieves root-relative production source directories.

constructors.description: Creates a generic fallback layout resolver for projects that do not match Maven, Gradle, JavaScript, or Python conventions.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout layout = new org.machanism.machai.project.layout.DefaultProjectLayout().projectDir(new java.io.File("/path/to/project"));
java.util.Collection<java.lang.String> documents = layout.getDocuments();
examples.description: Uses the default layout implementation to inspect documentation paths in an otherwise unrecognized project structure.

features.name: detectProjectLayout
features.description: Detects the appropriate project layout implementation for a directory. Maven projects are selected when pom.xml metadata is present, Gradle projects when Gradle build files are present, JavaScript projects when package.json is present, Python projects when Python metadata is present, and a default layout is used for existing directories that do not match a known ecosystem.

examples.description: Detects the project layout automatically and reads source, test, and documentation directories for downstream tooling.

features.name: getRelativePath
features.signature: java.lang.String getRelativePath(java.io.File dir, java.io.File file, boolean addSingleDot)
features.description: Computes a path for a target file relative to a project directory. The result can optionally be prefixed with ./ and is useful for storing stable project-root-relative paths in indexes, reports, and generated configuration.

examples.description: Returns a stable relative path such as ./src/main/java for use in generated metadata or reports.

features.name: getSources
features.description: Returns production source directories using the conventions of the selected layout implementation. This allows callers to avoid hard-coded paths when scanning Maven, Gradle, JavaScript, Python, or generic projects.

examples.description: Iterates over detected production source directories and resolves each one against the configured project root.

customizations.name: ProjectLayout implementation
customizations.description: Developers can create a custom subclass of org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout to support additional ecosystems or repository conventions by implementing getSources(), getDocuments(), and getTests().

examples.description: Shows how to implement a custom layout strategy for a project structure not covered by the built-in implementations.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout
studs.description: Base abstraction and extension point for project layout strategies. It defines common project directory configuration, source directory access, test directory access, documentation directory access, module metadata, relative path utilities, excluded directory rules, and temporary directory handling. Concrete implementations include MavenProjectLayout, GradleProjectLayout, JScriptProjectLayout, PythonProjectLayout, and DefaultProjectLayout.

examples.description: Uses the abstract ProjectLayout API after automatic detection, allowing callers to work with any supported layout implementation through the same contract.

examples.title: Install Project Layout in a Maven-based tool
steps: Add the org.machanism.machai:project-layout dependency to the Maven project that implements a scanner, plugin, generator, or validation tool.
Ensure Java 8 or later is available.
Run mvn clean verify to build and test the consuming project.
examples.description: This scenario installs the library as a normal Maven dependency so a developer tool can resolve source, test, resource, documentation, and module paths consistently.

examples.title: Detect and use a project layout in a repository scanner
examples.description: A scanner can call ProjectLayoutManager once for a project root, then use the returned ProjectLayout API to drive source analysis, test discovery, documentation generation, or indexing without hard-coded Maven, Gradle, JavaScript, or Python path rules.
